title: all-sigpack
description: `all-sigpack` is an overview help patch for the sigpack 0.0.45 signal-object library, listing objects for modulation, decimation, rectification, distortion, filtering, frequency processing, and other signal-shaping tasks. It serves as an index of available objects such as `sigpack/chop~`, `sigpack/decimate~`, and `sigpack/wavewrap~`; the patch provides no usage details beyond brief descriptions.
